newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle active at $69 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle active at $69 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was active in the Panhandle area early Wednesday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were $1.00 per cwt higher. Feedlots reporting good inquiry from buyers.
Sales reported on 34,500 slaughter steers and 21,700 heifers; 106,000 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 20,900 formulated cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 69.00. Select, few Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 67.00-68.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 69.00. Select, few Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 68.00. Utility to Choice 2-4 1050-1200 lb heiferettes 65.00-66.00.
